text:
Ravi: Mystery update: the Cerulean Kraken mug (blue, chip on the rim, proud tentacle sticker) has reappeared on the conference room table. Who's missing their sea monster?
Maya: OMG that's mine? I thought it went into the void after the merge party. :scream:
Chris: I ceremonially adopted that mug during Q3. It has my coffee karma now. :shipit:
Dina: We need a mug registry. Or a tiny plaque. Or both.
ops-bot: Note: Conference room cam recorded a brief cameo at 10:12am (no faces shown).
Ravi: Proposal: new policy 1: "Label your mugs or face the Kraken." :kraken:
Ivy: Vote: label it. Also someone put a tiny Post-it with a doodle of a squid on the mug and now it's sacred.
Maya: If there's a plaque, it should say: "Cerulean Kraken 024  Rescued from the dishwasher abyss."
Chris: Can we have a weekly "Mug Amnesty" box for unclaimed vessels?
Dina: Also raising a small complaint: the Kraken almost drank my turmeric latte last week. Territorial.
Ravi: ops-bot, can you make a quick poll: 1) Label and plaque 2) Mug registry doc 3) Forgive the Kraken and move on
ops-bot: Poll created: 1) Label and plaque 2) Mug registry doc 3) Forgive and move on. Voting open for 8h.
Ivy: Label + plaque. Low effort, big vibes. :label:
Maya: Plaque faction here. I'll design a tiny enamel sticker.
Chris: I vote for the Mug Amnesty box too. Old mugs deserve love.
ops-bot: Poll closed. Results: Label and plaque 3, Mug registry doc 1, Forgive and move on 1.
Ravi: Plaque it is. Maya's sticker design gets first dibs. Also adding "No hot soup" to the plaque rules.
Dina: Adding to lore: The Kraken prefers coffee, not broth. Noted for future. :coffee:
Maya: Will bring sticker sheet and a tiny sharpie tomorrow. Also filing the official Cerulean Kraken entry in the breakroom ledger.
Chris: Small applause for Maya and for whoever returned the mug. :clap:
Ravi: Closing thread. Next up: the Lost Plant saga. Stay tuned. :seedling:
